entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I need to start a return for an order. It's for a helmet I purchased.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Got it, thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the VeloFit Aero Helmet. It looks like it was delivered about 21 days ago. So, what specifically is the issue with the item?
There's no issue with it, functionally. The color just isn't what I expected, and I'd like to return it. The box is still unopened, so it's in perfect condition.
Okay, I understand. Just let me pull up the official return policy here to see what our options are.

Understood. Now, I know I'm a bit past the two-week mark. If a full refund isn't possible, I'd be willing to accept store credit. Or perhaps a 20% off coupon for my next purchase if that's easier than processing a return?

That's very reasonable of you, but it won't be necessary. I've just checked our policy, and you have 90 days from the delivery date for a return. Since you're only at 21 days, you are well within the window for a full refund.
Oh! Ninety days? I thought it would be much shorter. Well, that's fantastic news.

Absolutely. We want to make sure you're happy with your gear, especially when it comes to safety equipment like a helmet. Since the box is unopened, it's a very straightforward process. I've just initiated the return for you.
Great. So what are the next steps?

I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email on file right now. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives the helmet, your refund will be processed back to your original form of payment within 3 to 5 business days.
Perfect. That was much easier than I anticipated. Thank you for your help, Charlie.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
